title: biscutella laevigata subsp. cuneata
intro: Biscutella laevigata subsp. cuneata, commonly known as Alpine Penny-cress, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Penny-cress include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
